integrity: The universal rank-capacity formula is proved analytically from Weyl conjugation and support-difference geometry. The bundled computation is a finite consistency replay only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to full cyclic Gabor orbits and windows with exactly two nonzero coordinates. It does not determine the capacity for support size three or larger. The full text of the 2022 multi-window quantum-injectivity article was not available through the lawful open-access sources inspected, leaving a residual priority risk for unobserved examples in that article.
title: Sharp operator-span capacity of two-sparse multi-window Gabor systems
